name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Digital Attribution & Campaign Measurement | Google Tag Manager, GA4, Tracking Pixels, Campaign Analytics
summary: Digital marketing operator who sets up campaign tracking and turns the results into a story clients trust. I deploy Google Tag Manager, GA4 events, Meta Pixel, and Google Ads conversion tags on client sites, debug them in Preview mode and browser DevTools, and enforce UTM conventions so attribution holds up. Agency side at Level Agency I managed campaigns for ~3 accounts at $20K+/month in ad spend, built ROI and CAC reporting, and presented findings to non-technical client teams. Working SQL (BigQuery/GA4), Power BI, and Excel.
